styles.label: Responsive blast
styles.description: ResponsiveBlastWaveL — blade-angle positioned blast wave (transparent until blast).

styles.label: Responsive clash
styles.description: ResponsiveClashL — blade-angle positioned clash bump (transparent until clash).

styles.label: Lockup
styles.description: ResponsiveLockupL — localized bump at clash point, moves with blade angle.

styles.label: Responsive lockup
styles.description: Same as lockup — explicit ResponsiveLockupL overlay layer.

styles.label: Pulse layer
styles.description: Smooth breathing brightness pulse over layers below — scales all pixel colors equally (multiply). No ext/ret on layer line.

args.label: Pulse ms
args.hint: Milliseconds for one full brighten/dim cycle

styles.label: Swing layer
styles.description: Uniform swing brightening over layers below — preserves hue (multiply). No ext/ret on layer line (compositor does not clip multiply overlays).

args.label: Delta %
args.hint: Max brightness boost at full swing (e.g. 10 = +10%)

args.label: Speed threshold
args.hint: Swing speed at which boost reaches full strength (same scale as swing overlay)

styles.label: Base flicker
styles.description: Uniform brightness flicker over layers below — scales all pixel colors equally (multiply).

styles.label: Smoke flow
styles.description: Parallax rolling smoke wisps. extend_ms and retract_ms must match the solid/solid_bend base layer.

args.label: Extend ms
args.hint: -1 uses ignition sound length; must match solid/solid_bend base

args.label: Retract ms
args.hint: -1 uses retraction sound length; must match solid/solid_bend base

args.label: Roll speed
args.hint: 1 matches the current roll; higher rolls faster, lower rolls slower

styles.label: Per-LED flicker
styles.description: Independent random brightness per LED — multiply over any base to preserve hue. No ext/ret on layer line.

styles.label: Audio layer
styles.description: Hum-reactive uniform brightness — multiply over any base (composable alternative to the audio base style). No ext/ret on layer line.

styles.label: Gradient layer
styles.description: Hilt-to-tip gradient over layers below. No ext/ret on layer line (normal blend auto-clips to base in/out). Use normal blend; layer opacity controls mix (32768 = full, ~3277 = 10%).

styles.label: Rainbow layer
styles.description: Animated RGB rainbow over layers below. No args or ext/ret on layer line. Use normal blend; layer opacity controls mix vs base (32768 = full rainbow, ~3277 = subtle tint).

styles.label: Water flow layer
styles.description: WaterBlade idle texture — angle-reactive stripes and swing flow reversal (Fett263 OS7). Stack normal over solid_bend.

styles.label: Darksaber layer
styles.description: DarkSaber idle texture — metallic stripes, brown-noise, audio flicker, swing gleam (Fett263 OS7).

styles.label: Static electricity layer
styles.description: StaticElectricity charge texture — swing builds charge; clash/lockup resets (Fett263 OS7).

styles.label: Power wave layer
styles.description: PowerWave idle texture — wide slow reverse stripes (Fett263 OS7).

styles.label: Fallen order layer
styles.description: FallenOrder idle texture — wide stripes with pulsing mid-band (Fett263 OS7).

styles.label: Shimmer blade layer
styles.description: ShimmerBlade idle texture — HoldPeakF swing shimmer (Fett263 OS7).

styles.label: Rotoscope layer
styles.description: Rotoscope idle texture — SwingAcceleration OT bands (Fett263 OS7).

styles.label: Pulse stripes layer
styles.description: PulseStripes idle texture — ignition-surge stripes + pulsing mid-band (Fett263 OS7).

styles.label: Kinetic charge layer
styles.description: KineticCharge texture — clash/lockup build kinetic stripes; swing decay releases (Fett263 OS7).

styles.label: Rotating pulse layer
styles.description: RotatingPulse idle texture — Saw-modulated stripe direction reversal (Fett263 OS7 EnergyBlade).

styles.label: Trickle blade layer
styles.description: TrickleBlade idle texture — angle stripes + tip StaticFire trickle (Fett263 OS7).

styles.label: Cylon layer
styles.description: Cylon scanner band — stack with add over solid_bend (black sections add nothing).

styles.label: Spark tip layer
styles.description: Spark color at the extension front (InOutSparkTip). Match ext/ret to solid_bend base; stack with add or normal.

styles.label: Accent audio flicker
styles.description: GPIO accent: jittery hum-reactive flicker while saber is on.

styles.label: Accent pulse color
styles.description: GPIO accent: pulse from black to a chosen color while saber is on.

styles.label: Accent flicker
styles.description: GPIO accent: organic BrownNoise flicker while saber is on.

styles.label: Accent sequence
styles.description: GPIO accent: repeating timed pixel steps while saber is on (pixel,r,g,b,brightness,ms|…).

styles.label: Accent lockup
styles.description: GPIO accent: idle color with lockup/drag color when locked.

styles.label: Accent swing
styles.description: GPIO accent: brightens when swinging.

styles.label: Accent blast
styles.description: GPIO accent: idle color with blast flash while saber is on.

styles.label: Accent drag
styles.description: GPIO accent: off until drag lockup, then twist-responsive color.

styles.label: Accent melt
styles.description: GPIO accent: off until melt lockup, then twist-responsive color.

styles.label: Accent battery
styles.description: GPIO accent: brightness follows battery level while saber is on.

styles.label: Accent sparkle
styles.description: GPIO accent: random sparkle twinkle while saber is on.
